test_case.test_name: ED-24 independent APM change-default and qualified power-state restoration
test_case.purpose: Independently prove an approved APM change persists and restore selected factory or project target while measured power, idle/frequency, thermal, fan, throttle and protection behavior remains qualified.
required_package: Qualified BIOS/KVM operator, independent observer and maintenance window
DEFAULT_TARGET plus separate factory/project APM matrices
Reversible control, workload, telemetry cadence and limits
Backup, hard-abort, recipe and KVM/physical/CMOS recovery plan
test_case.test_command: For this row only, capture baseline APM page and calibrated telemetry; change one approved reversible control/group, save/reboot and prove retention/measured effect. Invoke firmware Load Defaults and record factory behavior. If DEFAULT_TARGET=PROJECT_RECIPE, apply approved recipe and reboot. Compare final page, power, frequency/idle, thermal, throttle, fan and protections to selected target.
test_case.expected_result: The change persists; every phase meets signed boot, telemetry, protection and error limits; factory behavior is separate; final menu and measured state exactly match selected Factory Default or Project Recipe.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only against declared target with row-specific screens and signed effective telemetry. Factory cannot satisfy Project Recipe. Protection loss, excursion, unstable/throttle/fan anomaly, wrong restoration or no-boot is FAIL. Missing target/limits/recovery is BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until target, matrices, value effects, workload, hard limits and recovery are signed.
Never execute all/random or disable thermal/current/voltage protections.
Drain workloads, preserve aligned BMC/SEL/kernel/thermal evidence and monitor independently.
Operator controls save/reboot/default/recipe/recovery; no automatic retry or CMOS clear.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, ED-11/ED-24 approval and platform/power/cooling identity
Declared target, factory/project matrices, control effects and limits
Unique baseline, changed, retained, Load-Defaults, optional recipe and final screenshots
Timestamp-aligned power, frequency/idle, temperature, throttle, fan and protection telemetry
Backup/restored state, discrepancy/recovery record and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop immediately on protection loss, excursion, instability or boot anomaly and preserve evidence. Qualified personnel restore backed-up project policy via signed recovery; do not reuse row 2182 evidence or automatically reboot/retry.
